description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Magistrate demo, step 3): refer the Q4 conflict to the demonstration Magistrate and argue ONE side: side 'forecast' (the model's +2.1%) or 'panel_b' (Panel B's +0.4%), plus optional reasons (up to 1,000 characters). Atlas attaches the other side's counterargument (written in advance). You cannot supply a ruling or file both sides. One referral per copy.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.
